Definition: Jotham, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jotham = "Jehovah is perfect"; 1) son of king Uzziah of Judah by Jerushah; king of Judah for 16 years and contemporary with Isaiah and king Pekah of Israel; 2) son of Jahdai and a descendant of Caleb and Judah; 3) youngest son of Gideon who escaped from the massacre of his brothers
